verdict.rationale: The skill documents a plain file-based install: copy the SKILL.md folder into the personal or project skills directory, and the agent then picks the skill up from its description. That step needs no prompts, so a coding agent could plausibly run it itself. Nothing states the path is designed or tested for unattended agent installs, and the /plugin marketplace commands are slash commands inside the host's interactive session rather than a headless installer the product ships. missing for 10: an explicit non-interactive or headless install command (e.g. a scriptable CLI or one-liner), documentation that an agent can complete the install end to end without user prompts, and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven install.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: Copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) or project skills directory
The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills
Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
